# CRD Berlin

> CRD Berlin (Carlos Richter Dienstleistungen) is a small, owner-run service company in Berlin, Germany. It offers property management, apartment cleaning, concierge services and lifestyle management for private clients, property owners (including owners living abroad), tenants, international professionals and businesses in Berlin. Clients have one personal local contact, reachable 24/7, in German, English or Spanish.

## Services

- **Property management (Hausverwaltung):** supervision of apartments, inspections, key handling, coordination of repairs, maintenance and tradespeople, communication with tenants, owners and building management.
- **Cleaning services (Reinigung):** regular apartment cleaning, deep cleaning, move-in / move-out cleaning, cleaning between tenants; can be combined with key handover and property checks.
- **Concierge services:** reservations, appointments, event planning, personal shopping, travel assistance, transport coordination and day-to-day organisation.
- **Lifestyle management:** ongoing personal assistance and household services.

## Key facts

- Area served: all of Berlin (office in Moabit, near Mitte, Tiergarten, Wedding and Charlottenburg)
- Languages: German, English, Spanish
- Availability: 24/7, replies usually within a few hours
- Founder: Carlos Richter Moreno; co-founder: Caroline
